methodology: Expected actions are concise semantic summaries manually reviewed against the listed primary or government sources. Only behavior explicitly attributed to exploitation of the CVE is included; campaign follow-on behavior is excluded. Technique/tactic pairs are reviewed against Enterprise ATT&CK 19.1.

cases.review_notes: The benchmark stops at exploitation of a vulnerable public-facing Log4j application and does not infer campaign payloads.

expected_steps.action: Send an attacker-controlled JNDI lookup value to a public-facing application using vulnerable Log4j
